messages.subject: shiny.js reuse
parts: Hi, I'm trying to develop a file input component using drag & drop feature to one of my apps. I had success on importing csv ( or any text file ) using jquery FileReader ( ) and readAsText ( ) , followed by Shiny.onInputChange(). Unfortunately this approach does not work with Excel files ( and other extensions ) . My objective is to make an input with a large spectrum , such as FileInput ( ) from shiny, preferably an input that would return a data frame such as FileInput ( ) . My question is: Is there any way to reuse some part of the functions present at shiny.js that are called by FileInput( )? Functions such as FileProcessor ( ) , uploadFiles( ), IE8FileUploader(), etc?
